narr: A strong upper level trough moved across Southern California December 27th through 29th of 2020, bringing areas of heavy rain and heavy mountain snowfall. Some communities saw flooded streets and snow covered roads, leading to travel disruptions and road closures.
ev: Public reports a swift water rescue in the channel near the intersection of Raitt Street and Edinger Avenue in Santa Ana. Reports of 2 people swept away in the channel.
